doc.brief: Determines how the size should be computed to achieve the one of the visibility mode for the scrollbars.
doc.md:
Determines how the size should be computed to achieve the one of the
visibility mode for the scrollbars.

always.md:
The scrollbar is always visible. The view size is
  independent of the content.

automatic.brief: The scrollbar will appear and disappear as necessary.
automatic.md:
The scrollbar will appear and disappear as necessary.
  For example, when all of a `GtkTreeView` can not be seen.

external.brief: Don't show a scrollbar, but don't force the size to follow the content.
external.md:
Don't show a scrollbar, but don't force the
  size to follow the content. This can be used e.g. to make multiple
  scrolled windows share a scrollbar.

never.md:
The scrollbar should never appear. In this mode the
  content determines the size.
